description: Link annotations on an existing PDF (pdfnative 1.9.0 through pdfnative-mcp 1.8.0): annotate_pdf type:'link' appends a /Link annotation with a /URI action to an existing page — the incremental-update twin of the link block of generate_basic_pdf, for documents the server did not build. The rect is the clickable area; http:, https: and mailto: only. The first step builds the document, the second adds two links and the third lists them.
